title: Counit-transpose coefficient comparison and tensor coherence
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $r\geq m\geq1$, $A=A_r=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$ and $B=A_m=\mathbf Z/\ell^m\mathbf Z$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth separated of finite type and pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ between Noetherian schemes (schemes admitting finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]) on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and suppose $f$ is compactifiable [def-asd-compactifiable]. Work in ordinary etale derived categories of constant-coefficient module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Here bounded constructible means finitely many nonzero cohomology sheaves, each constructible as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]; finite Tor amplitude means that some interval $[a,b]$ contains the cohomology of the derived tensor with every degree-zero module sheaf on that same small etale site. Write $P_A=Rf_{!,A}$, $G_A=f_A^\times$, $P_A\dashv G_A$ with counit $\varepsilon_A$ [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], and likewise over $B$; put $\omega_{f,A}=G_AA_Y$ and $S_T=(-)\otimes_A^LB$ on $T=X,Y$. Let $b_M:S_YP_AM\xrightarrow{\sim}P_BS_XM$ be the canonical coefficient comparison on bounded constructible finite-Tor inputs: form it on a compactification by the identity/zero extension-by-zero tensor comparison and the proper coefficient map adjoint to the proper inverse-image counit tensored with $B$. Suppose the $b$ for consecutive quotient rings obey their tensor-associativity cocycle. For bounded constructible finite-Tor $K$ on $Y$, the object $G_AK$ is bounded constructible finite-Tor, so $b_{G_AK}$ is defined. The counit transpose $c_K:S_XG_AK\to G_BS_YK$, specified by
$$\varepsilon_B(S_YK)\circ P_B(c_K)=S_Y(\varepsilon_A(K))\circ b_{G_AK}^{-1},$$
is natural in $K$. For $r\geq m\geq n\geq1$, one has $c_{r,n,K}=c_{m,n,S_{r,m}K}\circ S_{m,n}(c_{r,m,K})$ under the canonical derived tensor associators. If $\phi_{A,K}:f^*K\otimes_A^L\omega_{f,A}\to G_AK$ is the canonical tensor map, adjoint to inverse compact-support projection followed by $1\otimes\varepsilon_A(A_Y)$ [thm-asd-smooth-tensor], then
$$c_K\circ S_X(\phi_{A,K})=\phi_{B,S_YK}\circ(1\otimes c_{A_Y})$$
under the canonical scalar, pullback and tensor identifications. In any Cartesian base change of $f$ to a Noetherian scheme for which the base-changed morphism is compactifiable, the exceptional base-change maps $\beta$ of [prop-asd-smooth-base-change] commute with these $c$: applying scalar extension and $\beta$ in either order gives the same map from $S_{X'}g'^*G_AK$ to $G_{B,f'}g^*S_YK$. These assertions do not assume invertibility of $c$.
